task.title: Define environments so no account details live in the repo
task.description:
## Why
The site starts on a personal account and moves to a team account. That move should mean changing secrets, not code.

## Steps
1. Define two environments in the Wrangler config: `staging` and `production`.
2. Read the account id from the `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` environment variable. Do not write it in the config.
3. Document in `web/README.md` which values differ per environment and where each one is set.

## Done when
- `npx wrangler deploy --env staging` deploys to whichever account the shell's token and account id point at, with no file edits.
- Searching the repo finds no account id.
